mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies near the Verona Area High School with a temperature of 71 degrees. The moon is in a Waning Gibbous phase, and you can catch the International Space Station crossing the sky at 4:17 AM. It will rise in the northwest, pass over the high school area, and head toward the east northeast in the direction of Fitchburg, remaining low on the horizon for four minutes.

The Verona Senior Center is updating its flooring starting September 1. Expect limited services from September 1 to 4 and September 8 to 9, with a closure for Labor Day on September 7. You can see the full schedule at their open house on September 10. Also, crews are currently working on a water main break near 212 Todd Street, which has caused temporary water service shutoffs in that immediate area.

There is plenty to do in Verona! Today, you can catch trivia at Hop Haus or join the fun at Wisconsin Brewing Company for Quizmasters Trivia. Tomorrow, look forward to the Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, trivia at The Bogey Factory and Paddy Mac's, plus yoga at Insight Wellness and live music at Wisconsin Brewing Company.

In the weekly recap, on August 30, officers responded to a vehicle versus bicyclist crash on East Verona Avenue at Lincoln Street. The 15-year-old bicyclist was not injured, but the driver was cited for failing to yield the right of way.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Chocolate Heath Crunch. Please note that the store is currently closed, but it opens today at 10:00 AM.
